part_checkpoint.provenance: official MIT-licensed JetClass-supervised Particle Transformer (jet-universe/particle_transformer, arXiv:2202.03772), NOT the PKU jetfree-hh4b event-level classifier
part_checkpoint.load_convention: use_pre_activation_pair=False must be passed explicitly (class default is wrong for this checkpoint)
part_checkpoint.domain_mismatch_caveat: Checkpoint trained on JetClass large-R jets (R=0.8, pT 500-1000 GeV); applied here to AK4 jets (R=0.4, pT>30 GeV). Carried-forward project verdict: REVIEW_NEEDED / DOMAIN_SHIFT_REQUIRES_VALIDATION, never resolved to PASS. This is a scientific-validity caveat, not a data-availability blocker, and applies at every scale (2M/10M/144M). Must be stated alongside any result from this pipeline.
part_checkpoint.frozen_discipline: no gradient updates, no fine-tuning, no ParT inference inside SPA-Net epochs; embeddings are precomputed and consumed as static per-jet columns

native_2m_hdf5.split_construction: deterministic per-file cyclic_contiguous_window(offset, quota, mod=n_events_file); NOT a random seed-based split. manifest_train_2M.tsv (880 rows) / manifest_validation_400k.tsv (220 rows), columns: process, split_role, remote_file, sha256, rank, n_events_file, offset, quota, index_rule, wrapped

reweighting.weight_definition: p_uniform/p_mass, renormalized so mean in-range weight = 1.0

native_10m_baseline_for_go_nogo_referenc.note: Scaling 2M->10M on native features alone moved headline AUC by <0.001 in any bucket (0.9693->0.9693 all-bg, 0.9682->0.9678 qcd, 0.9754->0.9775 ttbar) -- i.e. 5x more native-only data bought essentially nothing on these metrics. This is the empirical bar the GO/NO-GO for ParT 2M->10M should be measured against: a ParT effect that is smaller than this null 5x-data effect is not obviously worth a 5x-larger, much slower (~232h estimated single-worker wall time for the 8M new-category ParT embeddings) production.

This package's own task is to recompute this from the COMPLETE, TRAIN-ONLY population once the gate passes, and to justify (not blindly reuse) the std<1e-3 threshold from that recomputation.
